title: Warm Dense Spanish Almonds Tarta De Santiago
description: A traditional Spanish dessert featuring warm dense almonds and a quick fix ssam wrap, this dish is halal friendly and perfect for a dessert or snack. It has a herbal flavor and a dense texture.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the flour and confectioners sugar.
Add the sliced almonds to the bowl and stir until they are well coated with the flour mixture.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the eggs, melted butter, and warm water.
Add the lemon zest to the egg mixture and stir until well combined.
Add the egg mixture to the almond mixture and stir until a dough forms.
Roll out the dough to a thickness of about 1/4 inch.
Cut out circles of dough using a cookie cutter or the rim of a glass.
Place a sheet of ssam wrap on a flat surface and place a circle of dough in the center of the wrap.
Fold the wrap over the dough to form a triangle and press the edges together to seal.
Place the tarta on a baking sheet and bake for 20 minutes.
